ev.q: AI/AN adults and black adults were substantially less likely than white adults and Asian adults to assess their health as excellent or very good.
SOURCES: Barnes PM, Adams PF, Powell-Griner E. Health characteristics of the American Indian and Alaska Native adult population: United States 1999--2003.

methods_quotes.q: Estimates are age-adjusted to the 2000 projected U.S. standard population using four age groups
